New Startup Sakana AI Wants To Build 🍃 Nature-Inspired Artificial Intelligence

Michael SpencerAug 21, 2023∙ Paid21Share

Hey Everyone, 

It’s exciting to see all of these LLM startups and organizations being founded in 2022 and 2023. A lot of talent has left Google and Meta AI in recent years to found their own startups. And now, new kinds of LLM startups are starting. I cover some of these in my Prospectus section of my Newsletter. 

 David Ha, is a poplar poster on X (Twitter), you can see this profile here. 

The landscape of generative artificial intelligence (gen AI) is in a rapid state of evolution these days and while it’s a horrible time to raise funds for most startups, if you are in the Generative A.I. space, you might have an easier time of it. 

Sakana AI is a new R&D-focused company based in Tokyo, Japan. The company is founded by David Ha and Llion Jones. It’s super interesting because they founders say they are creating a new kind of foundation model based on nature-inspired intelligence.
